findings.rationale: Pre-existing empty follow-up bullets in two legacy specs make global coverage partial. This does not waive a B21 requirement.
The off-capability protected disabling review without a sealed bundle fails closed without an escalation. Diagnostic gap only.
Noisy automatic-conclusion hint for off-capability legacy runs. Truthful source-loss diagnostics must be preserved.
On Windows checkouts with core.symlinks=false the alias materializes as a regular file and sealing fails closed. Not unsafe, but it needs a symlink-preserving checkout.
The alias regression calls the classifier and digest directly, not the subject builder (dirty, rename, removal). A future builder refactor could regress silently until a native seal.
